$schema.purpose: Explicitly accepted CLIENT-ONLY lint-staged guards — those invoked by no CI workflow. A guard absent from `clientOnly` and mirrored by no workflow is a FAILURE, not an unknown: the population is read exactly from package.json's lint-staged config, so there is no false-positive family to absorb.
$schema.whyThisExistsRatherThanSixWorkflows: A cold CI mirror for these guards reds on 593 pre-existing lines (measured 2026-08-08). Gating new violations from day one beats blocking every merger on a 593-line migration. This registry is the baseline; shrinking it is a visible lane rather than archaeology.
$schema.reason: REQUIRED. Why this guard has no CI mirror TODAY. Not 'because it doesn't' — the cost or blocker that keeps it client-only.
$schema.witness: REQUIRED. The measurement or artifact that substantiates the reason. An entry without one is a suppression, not an acceptance.
$schema.outOfScope: The `ai/scripts/lint/lint-*.mjs` family has its own coverage question and is NOT governed here. Recorded so the boundary is explicit rather than implied by omission.

buildScripts/util/check-block-alignment..reason: A CI mirror reds on pre-existing drift across the tree; the two known files are repaired in this ticket, but the guard checks whole files rather than changed lines, so a merge stages files the author never touched.
buildScripts/util/check-block-alignment..witness: compactGraphLog.mjs 17 violations and HeavyMaintenanceLeaseService.spec.mjs 14 at origin/dev 14c8f7dccb, with src/Neo.mjs at 0 as a firing control; PR #16703's merge required --no-verify.

buildScripts/util/check-derived-domain.m.reason: Scoped to test/**/*.mjs only; no measurement yet of how many existing specs a cold mirror would red.
buildScripts/util/check-derived-domain.m.witness: package.json lint-staged: listed under the `test/**/*.mjs` glob, not the repo-wide `*.mjs` one.

buildScripts/util/check-parse.mjs.reason: HIGHEST PRIORITY to mirror — a syntax guard with no CI backstop. Held only because the mirror should land with the shared workflow scaffolding rather than as a one-off.
buildScripts/util/check-parse.mjs.witness: package.json lint-staged `*.mjs` array; no .github/workflows file invokes check-parse.mjs (verified across every spelling, comments excluded).

buildScripts/util/check-shorthand.mjs.reason: Part of the 593-line pre-existing population a cold mirror would red.
buildScripts/util/check-shorthand.mjs.witness: Measured 2026-08-08 across the lint-* family: 593 pre-existing lines total.

buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs.reason: Runs on the `*` glob, so a cold mirror covers every file type in the repo; the pre-existing population is the largest and unmeasured per-guard.
buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs.witness: package.json lint-staged: the only guard under the repo-wide `*` glob.

ai/scripts/lint/lint-fleet-vocabulary-pa.reason: Found by this guard's FIRST RUN, not by the hand census that motivated the ticket — that census matched `check-*` only and was structurally blind to the `lint-*` family. Held pending the same shared workflow scaffolding as the others.
ai/scripts/lint/lint-fleet-vocabulary-pa.witness: package.json lint-staged invokes it under the `{ai/services/fleet/...,apps/agentos/config/...}` glob; no .github/workflows file invokes it (comments excluded). @neo-opus-grace reported 6/11 including the lint-* family before this ticket was filed; her count was the complete one.
